GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2019-03-08T16:14:16Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Top N elements group by time
Description: Following is a sample schema

```
{
    name String,
    dateTime String,
    ....
    value UInt32
}
```

We would like to group them by timeseries. However, we are interested only in the top 5 elements with the highest value sum. 

```
SELECT any(name),
       sum(value)
FROM TABLE
WHERE name IN
    (SELECT name
     FROM TABLE
     GROUP BY name
     ORDER BY sum(value) DESC
     LIMIT 5)
GROUP BY name,
         toRelativeMinuteNum(dateTime)
```

The above gives the top 5 elements in the `IN` call and which are then used to again be grouped by name with the time bucket.

However, we would also like to get the calculated internal `sum(value)` also separately. So

```
SELECT any(name),
       sum(value),
  (SELECT name
   FROM TABLE
   GROUP BY name
   ORDER BY sum(value) DESC
   LIMIT 5) AS topSumNames
FROM TABLE
WHERE name IN topSumNames
GROUP BY name,
         toRelativeMinuteNum(dateTime)
```

This above fails with the error 
```
DB::Exception: Scalar subquery returned more than one row
```

Questions:

1. How to get the internal sub query value also in the select output
2. Is there a better way to perform this top 5 elements

The `LIMIT BY clause` is not working, when we put in the `dateTime` in the grouping.
